description: This header file defines macros and utility functions for property and dependency property management in a Windows XAML application, including observable properties, command bindings, and dependency property registration.

methods.name: RegisterDependencyPropertyAttachedWithCallback
methods.description: Template function to register an attached dependency property with a callback.

methods.name: RegisterDependencyPropertyAttachedWithCallback
methods.description: Overloaded template function to register an attached dependency property with a default value and callback.

methods.name: IFTPlatformException
methods.description: Handles platform-specific exceptions given an HRESULT.

methods.name: IsLastCharacterTarget
methods.description: Checks if the last character of a string matches a target character.

methods.name: RemoveUnwantedCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes specified unwanted characters from a string.

methods.name: GetDoubleFromWstring
methods.description: Converts a wstring to a double.

methods.name: RunOnUIThreadNonblocking
methods.description: Runs a function on the UI thread asynchronously.

methods.name: GetUniversalSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current universal system time.

methods.name: IsDateTimeOlderThan
methods.description: Checks if a DateTime is older than a specified duration.

methods.name: WriteFileToFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously writes contents to a file in a folder.

methods.name: ReadFileFromFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously reads contents from a file in a folder.

methods.name: AreColorsEqual
methods.description: Compares two Color objects for equality.

methods.name: TrimFront
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the front of a std::wstring.

methods.name: TrimBack
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the back of a std::wstring.
